stories.title: Lula wins close Brazil election as Bolsonaro refuses to concede
stories.line: Lula narrowly won Brazil's presidential election over Flavio Bolsonaro, who has refused to concede, raising questions about the country's political stability.

stories.title: Taxes are due tomorrow; here's how to file for an extension
stories.line: Federal tax returns are due tomorrow, and filers who need more time can request an automatic extension.

stories.title: Filing: Chinese PCB maker Dongshan raised ~$1.3B in Hong Kong's biggest IPO in nearly two months, pricing shares at ~$11, or 35% below its Friday Shenzhen close (Bloomberg)
Country musician Ketch Secor calls on artists to oppose assault rifles after Nashville shooting
stories.line: Country musician Ketch Secor urges fellow artists to speak out against assault rifles after the Nashville school shooting.

stories.title: Israel heads to election as voters weigh fears and Netanyahu's future
stories.line: Israel holds an election under fears about security and Netanyahu's hold on power, with voters across the spectrum anxious about what comes next.

stories.title: House Democrats seek special counsel to probe Trump's Epstein ties
stories.line: House Judiciary Democrats are pushing for a special counsel to investigate Trump's ties to Jeffrey Epstein, a request not yet acted on.

stories.title: Trump attacks Michigan Senate candidate El-Sayed over his Muslim faith
stories.line: Trump used a Michigan rally to attack Democratic Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed over his Muslim faith, calling him a national security threat.

stories.title: Trump weighs Iran deal or military action to "finish them off"
stories.line: Trump says he is weighing a deal with Iran against military action to finish it off, a choice with war or peace at stake.

stories.title: Storm Boelo kills two men as 90,000 properties stay without power
stories.line: Storm Boelo killed two men by falling trees and left about 90,000 properties without power as clean-up begins.

stories.title: Serbia's Vučić concedes election defeat to student-led protest movement
stories.line: Serbia's long-ruling Aleksandar Vučić conceded a snap election to a student-led protest movement born from a deadly railway canopy collapse blamed on corruption.
